scripts.npm:package: cargo build --release --package tomlsmith-cli && pnpm npm:stage --binary target/release/tomlsmith && pnpm npm:build && pnpm npm:check && pnpm npm:pack
scripts.npm:test: cargo build --package tomlsmith-cli && pnpm npm:stage --binary target/debug/tomlsmith && pnpm npm:build && pnpm npm:check && pnpm npm:pack && vitest run --config npm/vitest.config.ts
scripts.npm:test:packed: vitest run --config npm/vitest.config.ts -t "the packed npm distribution installs an executable native CLI"
